payload.explanation: pg_stat_activity shows the business request (session_894e2ed6d2a4, pid 1685) blocked on transactionid waiting for pid 1682 (session_a5bdb844d657), which ran the same UPDATE inventory SET stock=stock-1 WHERE product_id=1 and is now 'idle in transaction' waiting on ClientRead, holding its row lock uncommitted. Two other idle-in-transaction sessions (session_e7bf003b7f40, session_70f137e8d313) hold no blocking role per pg_blocking_pids. No evidence of large data, index, or vacuum issues (tiny table, PK only). Uncertainty: none material; blocking chain is directly observed. Remediation path: roll back the eligible blocker session per policy, not the business request.
